name: crosscheck
description: CrossCheck — see the collisions before they happen

scripts.bootstrap: cd backend && npm install && cd ../infrastructure && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.synth: npm run build:frontend && cd infrastructure && npx cdk synth
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && cd infrastructure && npx cdk deploy
scripts.synth:no-cloudfront: npm run build:frontend && cd infrastructure && npx cdk synth -c cloudfront=false
scripts.deploy:no-cloudfront: npm run build:frontend && cd infrastructure && npx cdk deploy -c cloudfront=false
scripts.diff:no-cloudfront: cd infrastructure && npx cdk diff -c cloudfront=false
